note:
The whole-bundle config_sha256 of every configuration this revision applies, rendered on a host with the shared vision GPU present -- the host Rosalina states. config_sha256 is the digest the controller compares against the live container, so a change here is a change to what is running: not a refusal, a recreate. The paired configurations' bundles contain the Everyday resident's own launch (compose.services.everyday: its argv, its environment, its CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES with the vision card appended), so these five pins are what notice that a commit to the shared-vision placement moved the night-side model's projector or MTP draft along with it. Free-form profile keys -- warnings, retention, notes -- are not in the bundle, which is what makes a comment on a live configuration free; this fixture is the proof rather than a reading of config.py.

These three digests moved on 2026-10-20 and the two paired ones did not, which is the guard saying something true rather than something tedious: re-pinning the inference engine's image_id is a change to every bundle that runs that image and to none that does not, and the paired configurations -- and the Everyday resident inside them -- run a different image. The engine image moved from sha256:406ed64f (kept as local/strata:296b59d2f73c-vision-pre-cvec) to sha256:79fc1949, which adds overlay facts 9-11; the configuration in service keeps its workspace byte-identical under the new image because an unstated fact leaves the file alone, asserted by test_a_stated_nothing_leaves_the_workspace_exactly_as_it_found_it.
